blockers.quotedSubjectBytes: Predecessor ROW leftover-join. Historical. Measured OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED leftoverDesign true at HEAD 5d5d778 / required-now 26. Not current. Current DR-125 ROW leftover-join is sdk leftover-join.v5 (D-184). sdk leftover-join and g20 leftover-join are different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated. Not this artifact's version number.
blockers.attackSustained: sdk leftover-join.v5 is cited as current DR-125 leftover-join
blockers.constraintViolated: Dispatch prohibition: 'Do not record sdk leftover-join.v5 as current DR-125 leftover-join.' Dispatch premise: 'sdk leftover-join.v6 remains the current DR-125 leftover-join (D-267).'
evidence: Live COORD D-267 (line 13535, commit 1e3e664) reads: 'Record v6 as DR-125 leftover remasurement … leftover-join.v5 remains current at draft time. After this successor is recorded, leftover-join.v5 is not current.' D-267 IS recorded — it is an ancestor of live HEAD 7df63a6. Therefore sdk leftover-join.v5 is NOT current at the HEAD this candidate pins.

The sentence is a verbatim carry-over from frozen leftover-join.v4's basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role. It was true when v4 was drafted (v4 pins HEAD b7d1187, pre-D-267). v5's entire stated purpose contradicts it: purpose reads 'leftover-join.v4 cited sdk leftover-join.v5 as the current DR-125 leftover-join. Cite sdk leftover-join.v6 as the current DR-125 leftover-join.' The candidate states the correction it must make and then fails to make it in this block.

Internal contradiction inside the subject's own bytes: basedOn.sdkJoinV5.role says 'Not current. Current DR-125 ROW leftover-join is sdk leftover-join.v6 (D-267).' and basedOn.sdkJoinV6.role says 'Current DR-125 ROW leftover-join recorded at D-267.' Two blocks assert v6 is current; sdkJoinV4.role asserts v5 is current. The artifact cannot be recorded while it names two different artifacts as the single current DR-125 leftover-join.

This is not a harmless historical note. The clause is not scoped to v4's measurement epoch: the preceding sentence 'Measured … at HEAD 5d5d778 / required-now 26' is explicitly epoch-scoped, and the 'Current DR-125 ROW leftover-join is …' sentence is then stated unqualified in the present tense, exactly as sdkJoinV5.role and sdkJoinV6.role state their present-tense currency claims. Read by the document's own convention it is a live currency assertion.
blockers.whyMustFix: The candidate is a remasurement whose sole delta over frozen v4 is re-pointing DR-125 currency from sdk leftover-join.v5 to sdk leftover-join.v6 after D-267. The one block that had to be re-pointed was not re-pointed. Recording this artifact would enter a false currency claim into the record and would perform the precise act the dispatch forbids.
blockers.requiredRepair: In basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role, replace 'Current DR-125 ROW leftover-join is sdk leftover-join.v5 (D-184).' with a statement naming sdk leftover-join.v6 (D-267) as current — matching sdkJoinV5.role and sdkJoinV6.role. Any historical reference to v5's former currency must carry an explicit epoch qualifier (e.g. 'was current at D-184; not current after D-267').

shouldFix.quotedSubjectBytes: Predecessor. Unmoved. Dual ACCEPT 0/0. Recorded as current G20 leftover-join. Cited sdk leftover-join.v5 as the current DR-125 leftover-join. This v5 remasures leftover-join.v5 stale after leftover-join.v6 (D-267). Not this artifact's version number.
shouldFix.attackSustained: speaker labels / lineage custody — unqualified 'leftover-join.vN' resolves to the wrong lineage
evidence: Throughout this subject, unqualified 'leftover-join.vN' denotes the g20 lineage and the sdk lineage is always qualified: 'leftover-join.v4 remains frozen', 'leftover-join.v3 cited occupancy v1 as the specification', 'Recorded leftover-join.v4 as current G20 leftover-join' versus 'sdk leftover-join.v5', 'sdk leftover-join.v6'. The immediately preceding sentence in this very block uses the qualified form ('Cited sdk leftover-join.v5 as …'), then the next sentence drops it.

Read by that convention the sentence asserts that this v5 remasures g20 leftover-join.v5 — itself — stale after a g20 leftover-join.v6 that does not exist. The g20 lineage tops out at v5 (this candidate); `ls docs/coop/artifacts/g20-leftover-join.*` shows v1–v5 only.

The subject states the disambiguation rule three separate times ('sdk leftover-join and g20 leftover-join are different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated', in sdkJoinV4.role, sdkJoinV5.role and sdkJoinV6.role) and then violates it in the one sentence that carries the successor-staleness finding.

Frozen v4 wrote the analogous sentence unambiguously: basedOn.predecessorV3.role reads 'This v4 remasures occupancy v1 stale after occupancy v2 (D-217)' — artifact family named explicitly on both sides. v5 regressed that discipline.

The defect is load-bearing rather than stylistic: this sentence is where the candidate records WHAT its remasurement found stale. A remasurement whose staleness finding cannot be resolved to a lineage without external inference is not a self-carrying measurement.

coordinatorSummary: REJECT at 1 MUST-FIX and 1 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody is clean: live sha256 equals the dispatch digest da5a5420…, mode 0444, unmoved. All three frozen anchors are unmoved (leftover-join.v4 9de955ea…, occupancy v2 2c4823b7…, sdk leftover-join.v6 e91d6e92…). All 61 cited digests recompute against live bytes with zero mismatches. HEAD, last heading D-268, required-now 28, and file-08 token OPEN all match live. leftoverDesign is preserved at [OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING] and the obligation roster is identical to frozen v4. Twenty of twenty-two attacks are refuted. The candidate fails on the one thing it exists to do. Its stated purpose is to re-point DR-125 currency from sdk leftover-join.v5 to sdk leftover-join.v6 after D-267; basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role still reads 'Current DR-125 ROW leftover-join is sdk leftover-join.v5 (D-184)' — a verbatim carry-over from frozen v4, false at this HEAD (COORD D-267: 'After this successor is recorded, leftover-join.v5 is not current'), directly contrary to the dispatch prohibition, and self-contradictory against sdkJoinV5.role and sdkJoinV6.role which both name v6 as current. Separately, basedOn.predecessorV4.role writes 'This v5 remasures leftover-join.v5 stale after leftover-join.v6 (D-267)' without the 'sdk' qualifier, which under this document's own convention resolves to the g20 lineage and asserts a nonexistent g20 v6. Both defects are single-string repairs; nothing else in the candidate requires change.
